purpose: One settings line: label, quiet second line, current value on the right, optional chevron. Rows are the only focus stops in a settings page and each names its neighbours, so the walk is total even across a ScrollView.

anatomy.note: 16dp ink3, one line, 3dp below the label.
20dp ink2, end-aligned, 20dp after the text block.
Uppercase 19dp heading, 26dp above (0 for the first), 10dp below; not focusable.

rules: UP/DOWN step rows, skipping section headings.
The first row's UP goes to the page back control; the last row's DOWN stays (never wraps onto Back).
LEFT/RIGHT on a row with a picker opens/closes the picker, not another row.

behaviour: A row never shows a value it cannot set; read-only facts are notes, not fake pickers.
Focus is the pack's language: ring, lift or glow; no row changes height on focus.
The value column is right-aligned and never truncates the label below half its width.

platformDeltas.ios: Same anatomy with a 44dp minimum row height; DisclosureGroup/chevron semantics.
platformDeltas.windows: Hover row, keyboard focus ring; same value alignment.
platformDeltas.apple-tv: Focus lift; sections collapse into grouped lists with the same copy.
